purpose: Every externally sourced claim used by this repository, with its official link, so a human can verify each line by hand. Nothing here is inferred.

entries.claim: The competition, its task framing and its prize structure are the DOE GEMS Prize hosted by DrivenData as competition 306.

entries.claim: Metric definition: triangular kernel k(d) = max(1 - d/R, 0) with R = 300 m; alpha = 0.2; beta = 0.8; TP_w / (TP_w + alpha*FP_w + beta*FN_w); 100 m pixels.
entries.status: Transcribed into src/gems58/metric.py and reproduced verbatim in docs/research/metric.md; the transcription is what the tests and scripts/verify_theorems.py validate.
entries.label: OFFICIAL

entries.claim: Known USGS/INGENIOUS fault pixels are removed from scoring, so a prediction on a mapped fault is inert and cannot radiate kernel credit into the scored domain.
entries.status: Recorded by the sibling lane (GEMSDOE32 src/gems32/metric.py docstring) as the organizer clarification; not independently re-fetched here.
entries.label: OFFICIAL (second-hand transcription)

entries.claim: Submission format: a single-band GeoTIFF or a ZIP holding one GeoTIFF, matching the submission format's CRS, shape and geotransform; values in [0, 1].
